note: Claws and long arms: any solid surface can be climbed (characters excluded). The pull phase of each step now carries most of the body travel, so the climb reads as a continuous scramble at close to a jog rather than small bursts. Walking (up to 45 degrees) hands over to climbing at 46 degrees and a climber lets go below 38.7 degrees. Beyond 115 degrees there is no grip. W/S climbs vertically; A/D traverses. Jump leaves the surface; forward movement over a reachable lip mantles with collision checks.
